had to call 111 on Tuesday for some advice after being bitten by my cat and it looked infected and I was referred for a GP to call me back from Charlton Hill Surgery and within 10 minutes of putting the phone down to 111 I was called by Dr Briggs who was amazing.

Dr Briggs asked me to come straight down to the surgery where I was greeted by a lovely lady on reception who was really friendly and helpful and as soon as I sat down I was called instantly by Dr Briggs where she fully checked out the cat bite and prescribed antibiotics and she made sure I was seen straight after by a lovely nurse who gave me a tetanus.

From me talking to 111 I was seen by Dr Briggs within half an hour and I thought Dr Briggs was extremely helpful and very friendly and gave exceptional care and advice and this was followed by the most friendly nurse and her colleague for my tetanus.

I honestly have nothing but great things to say about Charlton Hill and they really are the best GP practice I have been with and it's clear how much they care about their patients and it doesn't matter who you deal with everyone is always very friendly and helpful.

I wanted to leave this review as people are quick enough to complain but never to say how great they are. I have always had a great experience with Charlton Hill and everyone who works there go above and beyond.

I wouldn't want to be with any other practice in Andover and this was another example of how good they are and I am really impressed with the swift treatment I received from Dr Briggs and the Nurse.

I can honestly say that my own GP who I normally see for ongoing medical conditions is an amazing lady and Dr Pyle is the first GP I have had who really does know my medical history who is always supportive and caring and I know I can trust.

I have seen most of the other doctors and nurses over the years and it doesn't matter who you see they all care about your health and welfare and they take the time to fully understand the problem and give the best treatment.

The reception team are always amazing and very friendly and they will get you an appointment straight away if urgent and normally the same day or they will book you for their first available appointment if it's not urgent and they couldn't do enough to help you.

I cannot give enough praise for Charlton Hill Surgery and they are a huge asset to Andover.",null,[0,238]]]],[null,1763072106000000,1763072106000000,"4 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/16070338068015545263/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUms1Vll6TmtNbEV4VTBSb1lXRllSbEpsVlVWNlRqQkdRbGxXUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/16070338068015545263/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUms1Vll6TmtNbEV4VTBSb1lXRllSbEpsVlVWNlRqQkdRbGxXUlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/16070338068015545263/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUms1Vll6TmtNbEV4VTBSb1lXRllSbEpsVlVWNlRqQkdRbGxXUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/16070338068015545263/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUms1Vll6TmtNbEV4VTBSb1lXRllSbEpsVlVWNlRqQkdRbGxXUlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/16070338068015545263/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUms1Vll6TmtNbEV4VTBSb1lXRllSbEpsVlVWNlRqQkdRbGxXUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/16070338068015545263/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUms1Vll6TmtNbEV4VTBSb1lXRllSbEpsVlVWNlRqQkdRbGxXUlJBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Thank you Adam for your review.
